ns2:course.label: Elements of Conducting
ns2:course.description: Fundamental elements of conducting, score analysis and preparation, transcription and transposition for choral and instrumental ensembles. Focused on development of conducting skills appropriate for use in public school teaching. A special section is offered for music majors not majoring in music education. Prerequisite: Music majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Music majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
